in_marathi.name: Baskar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Treasure
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baskar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Baskar is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Vasu’ (dwelling) and ‘Kara’ (maker), meaning the one who makes or dwells in the treasury of wealth. In Hindu mythology, Lord Baskar is a form of Lord Vishnu and is known to bestow wealth and prosperity.

In Hindu mythology, Lord Baskar is a form of Lord Vishnu and is known to bestow wealth and prosperity.
